text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be 
performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block
The oil treatment 
plant is 3 phase 380V, 50 HZ, 170 KW
The VH equipment is 
suitable for conditioning, inhibiting transformer oil, and drying transformer 
insulation or oil / paper insulation in general, this type of plant can be used 
to regenerate both oil and insulation, this increasing the lifetime 
of the transformer, the conditioning process eliminate the following components 
from the oil:
- Solid dirt
- Free and dissolved water
- Dissolved air
The first draft initiated by eng. Hussein Hashim 
Mohamed, 
tested & reviewed by eng. Hassib Hussein Bahbouh, accepted by general director eng. Mohamed 
Osama Soliman, approved by eng. Mohamed A. Basset Rekaby Head Sector of Aswan 
Dam 1& 2 hydraulic PS, and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakim 
HPGC MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear your 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, goggles, and 
 rubber glove. ...etc
Put the equipment ( mica file ) out of service.
Power supply is switched off.
All valves are switched off.
Tools and Equipment
Complete kit of tools, dry rags
Measuring instrument ( Ampere - meter )
Compressed air
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the exterior surfaces of the equipment plant
Check all fixing screws are tightened
Check all fuses.
Check oil level for vacuum pumps and change if necessary .
Clean coarse filter and change if necessary.
Check function test of all valves: (gear pump valves, safety valve, non return 
 valve, throttle valve)
Check function test of safety thermostat.
